outro: Tivora ERP. One platform. Every business.
master: This is Tivora ERP, from HiTech in Kathmandu.
One platform for every business, from the counter to the books.
Here is how it works. A bill is raised at the counter. The stock moves, the production floor knows what to make, and the ledger already has the entry. You type it once.
Every module sits on one Home screen, so nobody has to hunt through menus.
Search any entry with Control K, or star the ones you use every day.
The Work Desk shows the owner what needs attention each morning: a credit limit, a late order, a journal not posted.
And what is due, and who is keeping up.
Each module has its own dashboard, and one page shows the whole business.

Twelve modules work from the same books: sales and purchase, stock and production, transport and delivery, customer services, finance, fixed assets, trade finance, tax, reports, and the control panel.
A quotation becomes a sales order at the quoted prices. Every bill carries its V A T, paid or not. And letters of credit are followed from application to retirement.
Reports live in one searchable place: the day book, stock movement, and receivables ageing as a list, a pivot or a graph. The trial balance balances.
It is made for Nepal: Bikram Sambat dates, V A T registers, T D S, and Annex nine and thirteen.
Jewelry is available now. General trading and Paint are next.
Tivora ERP. One platform. Every business.
Request a demo, and see it on your own numbers.
owner: Everything starts on Home. Your most used entries are one click away.

The Work Desk is where the day begins. It gathers what needs you from every module, sorted by late, today, this week or snoozed. A customer is over the credit limit. A production order is weeks late. A journal has not been posted. Each one has its action beside it, so you fix it there.
Then the numbers: who owes you, and whom you owe, in one view.
Sales for the last thirty days. The V A T this month, output less input. And work assigned, done, on time or overdue.
Every module has a dashboard of its own. Sales against the same days last month, a running total against target, and what customers owe.
Tivora ERP. One platform. Every business.
money: This is where the money is kept: vouchers, books, cheques and the final accounts.
Receipts, payments and contra entries are made against a cash or bank book, so every rupee has a place.
When an import-loan or L C payment is made, its voucher posts by itself. Nobody retypes it.
Every voucher stays in date order, in B S and A D, so any entry can be found and checked.
The trial balance is always up to today, and it balances.
From it come the profit and loss, balance sheet, cash flow and funds flow.
Fixed assets have their own register, with depreciation and the asset schedule built in.
Trade finance is covered too: letters of credit, import loans and bank guarantees, from application to retirement, with foreign currency revalued at month end.
For tax: V A T registers, Annex nine and thirteen, and T D S certificates by party.
It is C B M S ready, and built to I R D's current formats.
stock: One entry moves the stock, from purchase to delivery.
Buying starts with a requisition and a request for quotation. Supplier quotes are compared side by side, import costs are pooled into the goods, and what is received but not yet billed stays visible.
In the godown: indents, approvals, transfers and stock audit, with batches, H S N codes and every godown tracked.
Stock is valued, and you see opening, inward, outward and closing for every product.
On the floor: plan, order, issue, receive. Bills of materials, plants and machines, with yield, loss and batch trace.
A late order reaches the owner's desk by itself.
Delivery runs on your own vehicles or hired transporters, with freight bills and document expiry.
The floor knows what to make, and the ledger already has it.
Tivora ERP. One platform. Every business.
sales: The day starts at the counter, with price lists, discount schemes, counters and tills.
Sales below the floor price, and temporary credit limits, are reported.
A quotation becomes the sales order at the quoted prices, so nothing is entered twice.
Every bill is dated in both calendars.
Each line carries its V A T, and every bill shows paid, partly paid or unpaid.
You see what each customer still owes, in ageing bands, as a list, a pivot or a graph.
Over the credit limit? The Work Desk flags it, and so does the dashboard.
Tivora ERP. One platform. Every business.
